title: HostCover Property-Damage Reimbursement Booking: Desk Reference
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** settles a property-damage claim that the claims team has approved on a HostCover plan. The figure booked is the property reimbursement Roamhaven pays on that claim, and every base condition on paying a claim continues to apply: approval, escalation in time, coverage of the stay, and one reimbursement per claim.

## What the tool does

`pay_property_damage_reimbursement_941cbbf5` books the HostCover reimbursement Roamhaven pays the host on one approved property-damage claim. One call records a single reimbursement entry on the HostCover ledger of the plan the property-damage claim was filed under, carrying the claim, the stay the damage arose from, the loss the claims team verified on the claim, the date of the call and the reimbursement amount passed in. The plan's reimbursements grow by that amount and the claim shows as reimbursed in the HostCover ledger from then on; the payout desk credits the money to the host's default payout method. The entry is visible at once in the HostCover ledger lookup for the claim.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: unlock `pay_property_damage_reimbursement_941cbbf5`, then call it.

## Parameters

- `claim_id`: the reference number of the approved property-damage claim being reimbursed, as returned by the damage-claim lookup for the host's HostCover plan. An identifier; no fixed list of values.
- `amount`: the reimbursement Roamhaven pays on the claim. A positive USD amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent, with no currency symbol; no fixed list of values.

## What comes back

A receipt with `status` set to `reimbursement_booked` when the entry was written, `protection_event_id` (the reference number of the new ledger entry), `claim_id` (the property-damage claim reimbursed), `stay_id` (the stay the claim arose from), `amount` (the reimbursement booked in USD, 2 decimal places) and `posted_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract questions

**Does the tool round the amount?** The amount passed is expected already rounded to the cent; the receipt shows the amount booked to 2 decimal places.

**Where does the money go?** To the host's default payout method, credited by the payout desk.

**Which plan's ledger receives the entry?** The ledger of the HostCover plan the property-damage claim was filed under.
